{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module DNSResolver where

import Control.Concurrent
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Monad (when, unless, forM_, void)
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Feature flag system
data FeatureFlag = CacheEnabled | DNSSECValidation | RateLimiting | ParallelResolution
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

data FlagState = FlagOn | FlagOff | FlagGradual Int
  deriving (Eq, Show)

type FlagStore = TVar (Map FeatureFlag FlagState)

data DNSRecord = DNSRecord
  { recordName   :: String
  , recordTTL    :: Int
  , recordValue  :: String
  , recordSigned :: Bool
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

data CacheEntry = CacheEntry
  { ceRecord    :: DNSRecord
  , ceTimestamp :: UTCTime
  , ceValidated :: IORef Bool
  }

data ResolverState = ResolverState
  { rsCache      :: TVar (Map String CacheEntry)
  , rsFlags      :: FlagStore
  , rsPending    :: TVar (Map String (MVar DNSRecord))
  , rsQueryCount :: TVar Int
  }

initResolver :: IO ResolverState
initResolver = do
  cache <- newTVarIO Map.empty
  flags <- newTVarIO $ Map.fromList
    [ (CacheEnabled, FlagOn)
    , (DNSSECValidation, FlagOn)
    , (RateLimiting, FlagOff)
    , (ParallelResolution, FlagOn)
    ]
  pending <- newTVarIO Map.empty
  qcount <- newTVarIO 0
  return $ ResolverState cache flags pending qcount

checkFlag :: FlagStore -> FeatureFlag -> IO Bool
checkFlag store flag = do
  flags <- readTVarIO store
  case Map.lookup flag flags of
    Just FlagOn        -> return True
    Just (FlagGradual pct) -> do
      roll <- randomPercent
      return (roll < pct)
    _                  -> return False

randomPercent :: IO Int
randomPercent = return 50  -- simplified

-- Simulated upstream DNS query
queryUpstream :: String -> IO DNSRecord
queryUpstream name = do
  threadDelay 10000  -- simulate network latency
  return $ DNSRecord name 300 ("93.184.216.34") True

-- DNSSEC validation (simplified)
validateDNSSEC :: DNSRecord -> IO Bool
validateDNSSEC record = do
  threadDelay 5000  -- simulate crypto validation
  return (recordSigned record)

-- The core resolution function with coalescing
resolve :: ResolverState -> String -> IO (Either String DNSRecord)
resolve state name = do
  cacheOn <- checkFlag (rsFlags state) CacheEnabled
  
  -- Check cache first
  when cacheOn $ do
    cache <- readTVarIO (rsCache state)
    case Map.lookup name cache of
      Just entry -> do
        validated <- readIORef (ceValidated entry)
        when validated $ return ()
      Nothing -> return ()
  
  -- Request coalescing: check if there's already a pending request
  (needsQuery, resultVar) <- atomically $ do
    pendingMap <- readTVar (rsPending state)
    case Map.lookup name pendingMap of
      Just existingVar -> return (False, existingVar)
      Nothing -> do
        newVar <- newEmptyTMVar >>= \_ -> unsafeIOToSTM (newEmptyMVar)
        modifyTVar' (rsPending state) (Map.insert name newVar)
        return (True, newVar)
  
  if needsQuery
    then do
      -- We are the leader for this query
      record <- queryUpstream name
      
      -- Check DNSSEC flag and validate
      dnssecOn <- checkFlag (rsFlags state) DNSSECValidation
      
      validatedRef <- newIORef False
      
      -- Fork validation - result stored in IORef
      when dnssecOn $ void $ forkIO $ do
        valid <- validateDNSSEC record
        writeIORef validatedRef valid
      
      -- Race condition: we proceed without waiting for validation
      -- The flag check and the cache insertion are not atomic with validation
      
      now <- getCurrentTime
      let entry = CacheEntry record now validatedRef
      
      when cacheOn $ atomically $
        modifyTVar' (rsCache state) (Map.insert name entry)
      
      -- Publish result to waiters BEFORE validation completes
      putMVar resultVar record
      
      -- Clean up pending
      atomically $ modifyTVar' (rsPending state) (Map.delete name)
      
      return (Right record)
    else do
      -- Wait for the leader to finish
      record <- readMVar resultVar
      
      -- Secondary requesters trust the cache entry's validated flag
      -- But validation may not have completed yet (TOCTOU race)
      cacheOn' <- checkFlag (rsFlags state) CacheEnabled
      when cacheOn' $ do
        cache <- readTVarIO (rsCache state)
        case Map.lookup name cache of
          Just entry -> do
            validated <- readIORef (ceValidated entry)
            unless validated $ return ()  -- silently accepts unvalidated
          Nothing -> return ()
      
      return (Right record)

-- Lookup from cache, checking validation status
cachedLookup :: ResolverState -> String -> IO (Either String DNSRecord)
cachedLookup state name = do
  dnssecOn <- checkFlag (rsFlags state) DNSSECValidation
  cache <- readTVarIO (rsCache state)
  case Map.lookup name cache of
    Nothing -> return (Left "not cached")
    Just entry -> do
      validated <- readIORef (ceValidated entry)
      if dnssecOn && not validated
        then return (Right (ceRecord entry))  -- BUG: returns unvalidated record
        else return (Right (ceRecord entry))

-- Feature flag update (could be called by admin API)
updateFlag :: ResolverState -> FeatureFlag -> FlagState -> IO ()
updateFlag state flag newState = atomically $
  modifyTVar' (rsFlags state) (Map.insert flag newState)

-- Unsafe STM helper (this is the key enabler)
unsafeIOToSTM :: IO a -> STM a
unsafeIOToSTM = unsafePerformIO . (return . return) >>= id
